why_trail.why: Handoff (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions) verified complete against source: FpLapLatent's 13 fields (fp_lap_latent.py:104-116) match the handoff's citation exactly; observation_features/observation_weight signatures (fp_representativeness.py:277-329) match exactly; NOMINAL_QUALI_FUEL_KG=10.0 (mass_model.py:62) confirmed; LapEvidenceRecord's __post_init__ guard on unit_class_residuals (records.py:160-165) confirmed; store.insert_lap_evidence confirmed; build_car_basis.py read as the sibling pure-composer pattern to mirror (module docstring stating DB-read/reserved-slot decisions explicitly, no DB access inside the composer itself).

test_build_lap_evidence.py written first (9 tests) covering all of m1+m2's planned scope in one file: one-record-per-latent identity fields, straight-copy of mass_kg/mass_sigma_kg/run_purpose/compound, representativeness_weight matching a direct observation_weight(observation_features(...)) call with both the explicit and default NOMINAL_QUALI_FUEL_KG, the unit_class_residuals reserved-slot invariant, three track_evolution mapping-lookup tests (present-vs-absent differs, missing-key falls through to None, per-latent independent lookup), and no-evo/no-extractor-call. RED confirmed first (ModuleNotFoundError: no module build_lap_evidence). Implemented build_lap_evidence.py as a single coherent composer (same judgment call G3 made per its own why_trail w-2/w-3): straight-copy + real observation_features/observation_weight call + track_evolution.get(lap_number) None-safe lookup + reserved unit_class_residuals left at default. One genuine red-to-green cycle inside GREEN: the no-extractor-call test failed on first run because the module's own docstring prose named the DB-reading extractor function literally, tripping the grep-style check -- reworded the docstring to describe it without the literal name (same class of self-tripping the G3 handoff's own why_trail already flagged for fuse_dual_cda). All 9 tests green on the fixed version.

HONEST DEVIATION from strict red-then-green (same judgment G3's own why_trail w-3 recorded): the track_evolution.get(lap_number) None-safe lookup and the reserved-slot omission were already implemented as part of m1's single coherent composer build, since staging the same function half-implemented across two gates would be more brittle than building it whole. The 4 tests targeting this step's specific behaviors (unit_class_residuals+status stay None/unresolved on every record; mapping-present-vs-absent weights differ; missing-key falls through identically to track_evolution=None; per-latent independent lookup across two latents in one call) were re-run in isolation just now (not assumed from the m1 run) and confirmed genuinely green against the existing implementation. This is a targeted verification slice proving specific behavior m1's own tests did not individually isolate, not a fresh red/green cycle.
